title: ee.audit.memory_anchor_freshness_transition.v1
description: Audit-details payload for one code-coupled memory-anchor freshness transition (ADR-0056, bd-1n0np.3.7). Stored in audit_log.details for action 'memory.freshness_transition'. Redaction-safe: it carries only the anchor's domain-separated BLAKE3 hash, never the raw anchor value.

anchorValueHash.description: Domain-separated BLAKE3 hash of the normalized anchor value. The raw value is never persisted.

driftCode.description: Drift classification when drift-driven; null for non-drift transitions such as an explicit revalidation.

fileLine.description: Live file:line of the resolved symbol at detection time; null under rename/move ambiguity.

automatic.description: True when written by an automatic drift check; false for an explicit/manual transition.

detectedAt.description: RFC 3339 timestamp of the transition detection.

detailsHash.description: BLAKE3 over the redaction-safe payload, appended after construction.
